explanation: Two interacting defects in shortest_path. (1) The BFS queue was seeded with an empty path `(start, [])`, so every returned path omitted the start node; e.g. the visible check returned ['b'] instead of ['a','b']. Fixed by seeding `(start, [start])` so paths include the start (and start==goal correctly yields [start]). (2) The start node was never marked visited (`seen=set()`), so any cycle leading back to start would re-enqueue it and explore redundant non-simple paths. Fixed by initializing `seen={start}`. Marking neighbours seen at enqueue time and scanning `graph.get(node, [])` in listed order were already correct and are preserved.
